mappings.assertion: TestOracleA9OrchestratorTurn: orchestrator woken by an unseen human note; raw at-launch entry is role orchestrator, status PLANNING, current_task planning, lease equal to heartbeat +1800 s; a turn exiting 0 marks the note seen after the turn only, a turn exiting 1 leaves it unseen and is not relaunched

TestOracleA9OrchestratorPlans i13-cleared, i13-kept and i13-guard: a resumed PLANNING_COMPLETE transition checkpoint has its trigger cleared before the turn launches; a resumed SPRINT_COMPLETE hard checkpoint keeps it in the before, at-launch and after states (the gate cell); the callback guard is pinned through an AC2 adapter over the exported ops.SameResumedTransitionCheckpoint on five fixture sprint pairs: the same checkpoint gives true, a newer checkpoint, another trigger, another sprint or a sprint checkpointed again give false, so the trigger is kept (decision D44)

TestOracleA9OrchestratorPlans i14-undecided and i14-decided: a merged plan left without disposition after a PLANNING_COMPLETE turn gets exactly one plan_handoff_undecided history entry and the PLAN DISPOSITION MISSING alert; a plan held by the turn gets neither

TestOracleA9CheckpointSummary: a pending summary at a sprint checkpoint is claimed before the stub summary CLI runs once with the checkpoint-summary prompt and writes the report (no alert); a failing summary CLI raises the CHECKPOINT SUMMARY FAILED alert; a checkpoint whose obligation is already consumed emits no summary CLI call, report or alert after a full gate poll, observed mid-run before resume and stop; i15-pending holds the first summary CLI on a wait file, raises a second obligation through resume and sprint-checkpoint, and shows it unclaimed with one CLI call over two gate polls (in-flight guard), then claimed and run once the first ends (decision D44: success pins the observed pending summary without alert); every orchestrator test is serial (Go runs it while parallel tests are paused) and ends with D45/D48 cleanup (orchreap_test.go, orchreap_linux_test.go): a Linux child subreaper, then every child of the test process, including zombies without an environment or prior record, is signalled with its process group, reaped through deadline-bounded Wait4, and the actual child set is asserted empty on normal, deadline and failure paths; each supervisor group is also terminated best-effort on every Unix host (orchStart); TestOracleA9OrchestratorReap cancels the supervisor while the provider stub is held and covers live and exited providers; TestOracleA9OrchestratorAdoptedZombie uses Waitid WNOWAIT in a helper parent to leave an exited child, waits for that parent to exit, then first discovers the already-adopted zombie and requires no children after cleanup
